description: Returns the documented upstream API response directly without an additional wrapper.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Response code, 200 indicates success

fields.name: msg
fields.description: Message, ok on success, error description on failure

fields.name: data
fields.description: Array of keyword metric records, each corresponding to a (site, keyword) combination, approximately 37 fields, sorted by collection time descending

fields.name: data[].amazonDomain
fields.description: Site code (currently fixed US)

fields.name: keyword
fields.description: Original search keyword

fields.name: data[].nicheName
fields.description: Normalized niche name (snake_case)

fields.name: nicheRevenue360dMinUsdAtLeast/nicheRevenue360dMaxUsdAtLeast
fields.description: Last 360 days market revenue lower bound / upper bound (USD)

fields.name: nichePeakSearchVolumeAtLeast
fields.description: Peak monthly search volume

fields.name: nichePeakMonth
fields.description: Search peak month (1-12)

fields.name: nicheSearchVolumeYoyChangePctAtLeast
fields.description: Search volume YoY change rate (%, signed)

fields.name: nicheBrandCount/nicheBrandCountYoyChangePctAtLeast
fields.description: Active brand count and its YoY change rate

fields.name: nicheTop5ProductClickSharePctAtLeast
fields.description: Top 5 product click share (0-100)

fields.name: featureTop5BrandSharePctAtLeast
fields.description: Top 5 brand combined share (0-100)

fields.name: featureTopBrands
fields.description: Top 3 brand name list (original text)

fields.name: priceMinUsd/priceMaxUsd
fields.description: Niche overall minimum / maximum product price

fields.name: priceSweetSpotMinUsd/priceSweetSpotMaxUsd
fields.description: Value sweet spot price range lower bound / upper bound

fields.name: priceEntryClickSharePctAtLeast/priceMidClickSharePctAtLeast/priceHighClickSharePctAtLeast
fields.description: Entry / Mid / High tier click share (0-100)

fields.name: demoPrimaryAgeMin/demoPrimaryAgeMax
fields.description: Core audience age lower bound / upper bound

fields.name: data[].demoGenderDominant
fields.description: Dominant gender (female / male / mixed / unspecified)

fields.name: data[].demoPrimaryIncomeTier
fields.description: Core audience income tier

fields.name: demoLifeStageTags
fields.description: Life stage tag list

fields.name: featureNewAvgReviewCountAtLeast/featureEstablishedAvgReviewCountAtLeast
fields.description: New / Established product average review count

fields.name: featureEmergingTrendTags/featureUncommonFeatureTags
fields.description: Emerging trend / Rare differentiation feature tags

fields.name: data[].searchTopCategory1Label
fields.description: Traffic top category 1 normalized label

fields.name: reviewPositiveTop1Topic/reviewPositiveTop1PctAtLeast
fields.description: Positive review #1 topic and its share among positive reviews

fields.name: reviewNegativeTop1Topic/reviewNegativeTop1PctAtLeast/reviewNegativeTop2Topic
fields.description: Negative review #1 topic, share, and secondary cause

fields.name: reviewStrategicInsightTags
fields.description: Review strategic insight tags

fields.name: errcode
fields.description: Upstream status code returned by the provider.

fields.name: errmsg
fields.description: Upstream status message returned by the provider.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Provider-specific message.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Provider-specific render or payload type.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Provider-specific response title.

fields.name: sourceType
fields.description: Provider-specific source platform type.

fields.name: sourceTool
fields.description: Provider-specific source tool name.

fields.name: costToken
fields.description: Token cost reported by the upstream provider.

fields.name: costTime
fields.description: Execution time reported by the upstream provider.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Page size returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageItemCount
fields.description: Item count on the current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: totalPage
fields.description: Total page count returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: dataSnapshotMonth
fields.description: Data snapshot month returned by the upstream provider.
